name: Mire Materia Hunt

start.dialog: Heard there's a special materia hidden in the Mire. Something ancient. Probably from before the cataclysm. Help me find it? I'll teach you some martial arts in exchange!
start.objective: Search the Mire for ancient materia hidden in the depths

progress.dialog: The readings are strongest near the old ruins. But the mud makes it hard to pinpoint exactly.
progress.objective: Continue searching near the old ruins

complete.dialog: There it is! 'Bio' materia! Nature magic. Fitting for this place. Here - as promised. A martial arts manual. Some of my favorite techniques.

party_comments.kade: She's tough. Glad she's on our side.
party_comments.twist: I want to learn to fight like her! So cool!
party_comments.grit: Efficient striking form. Good for close quarters.

hidden_outcome: If you find a second 'Summon' materia nearby, Tifa gives you her 'Premium Heart' gloves - her ultimate weapon
